title: R.K.Fashion Accessories IPO Details
intro:
R.K.Fashion Accessories IPO is a book build issue of ₹34.99 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 42.67 lakh shares of ₹34.99 crore.

R.K.Fashion Accessories IPO opens for subscription on Oct 5, 2026 and closes on Oct 7, 2026. The allotment for the R.K.Fashion Accessories IPO is expected to be finalized on Oct 8, 2026. R.K.Fashion Accessories IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 12, 2026.

R.K.Fashion Accessories IPO is set issue price band at ₹77 to ₹82 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,62,400 (3,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (4,800 shares), amounting to ₹3,93,600.

Affinity Global Capital Market Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Cameo Corporate Services Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Anant Securities

Refer to R.K.Fashion Accessories IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in March 2010, R.K. Fashion Accessories Limited is engaged in the manufacturing through contract manufacturers and wholesale distribution of imitation jewellery, along with the trading of branded cosmetics. Its product portfolio comprises handcrafted imitation jewellery incorporating traditional designs with contemporary styles, catering to various segments through wholesale and direct sales channels. The Company operates with a focus on the B2B and B2C segments, supplying its products through wholesale channels while expanding its direct presence among individual consumers. It has also adopted a multi-platform e-commerce strategy and has established corporate tie-ups to support its sales and customer base. The Company has purchased a property on Rash Behari Avenue, Kolkata, which is currently under construction and is intended to strengthen its retail presence and expand its B2C customer base in Kolkata, particularly in areas with relatively lower concentration of its existing B2B customers.

The Company focuses on product quality through multi-stage inspection and quality control processes and maintains relationships with its customers through its B2B operations. Its business model combines traditional jewellery designs with contemporary styles while expanding its sales reach through wholesale, retail and online channels. The Company also aims to diversify its customer base through greater penetration of the B2C segment.

As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 50 permanent employees, including directors and key managerial personnel, supported by contractual labour engaged according to business requirements and high-volume orders. Its workforce comprises personnel across operations, management, finance, marketing, design, sales, customer service, packaging, quality control and human resources.
strengths: Multi-stage quality inspection and product reliability.
Blend of traditional and contemporary jewellery designs.
Diversified sales channels across wholesale, retail and online platforms.

faqs.question: How to apply in R.K.Fashion Accessories IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in R.K.Fashion Accessories IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in R.K.Fashion Accessories IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in R.K.Fashion Accessories IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' R.K.Fashion Accessories IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for R.K.Fashion Accessories IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in R.K.Fashion Accessories IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .
